verdict.rationale: Carts carry attribution metadata (referring_domain, click_id, activity_id, UTM fields), and create_checkout inherits that metadata from the cart. Every agent identifies itself via a UCP profile, and orders are tracked as 'placed through your agent', so per-agent attribution data plausibly reaches the order. However, nothing in the pack shows merchant-side reporting, analytics, or filtering of transactions by agent; the order visibility documented is agent-facing (Order MCP, webhooks). Missing for 10: merchant admin reporting or filtering by agent, confirmation that attribution persists onto the merchant's order record, and any hands-on corroboration.
